title: Alcaraz's comeback win sends Jodar to the ATP Finals
summary:
Carlos Alcaraz saved two match points and fought back to beat Taylor Fritz 6-7 (10-12), 7-5, 6-3 on Friday, November 6. The win did more than send Alcaraz into the semi-finals. It also booked a place at the season-ending ATP Finals for 20-year-old Spaniard Jodar. Fritz edged a tight first set, winning the tie-break after both players had chances to take it. Then he moved a break ahead in the second set, and the match looked like it was slipping away from Alcaraz. But the 23-year-old Spaniard refused to fold. He saved two match points, broke Fritz twice, and levelled the match. From there, he took charge. Alcaraz moved 3-1 ahead in the decider and closed out the contest with a powerful forehand. 'I tried not to let myself down in those difficult moments — to stay strong mentally,' Alcaraz said.

Alcaraz will face either Casper Ruud or Nuno Borges in the semi-finals. Jodar's place at the finals in Turin, Italy, is now secure. The event, held at Turin's Inalpi Arena from November 15 to 22, features the top eight men's singles players in the world. Jodar will make his debut there, as will American Frances Tiafoe, 28. Tiafoe's spot was confirmed earlier, when Tommy Paul lost 6-4, 4-6, 6-3 to fellow American Ben Shelton. The eight qualifiers are Alexander Zverev, Daniil Medvedev, Flavio Cobolli, Arthur Fils, Alcaraz, Shelton, Tiafoe and Jodar.

Jodar only became a full-time professional at the beginning of 2026, but his debut season has drawn major attention. The Madrid-born youngster won three ATP Challenger titles in 2025 and claimed his first ATP Tour title in Marrakech in April 2026. Tiafoe, nicknamed 'Big Foe', is a three-time ATP Tour title winner known for his energetic style and passionate celebrations. He reached the US Open semi-finals in 2022 and 2024.
why_it_matters: The ATP Finals gathers the season's top men's singles players, so qualifying marks a player as one of the year's best, and for Jodar it caps a first full-time season that has already brought titles and major attention.
